entities.name: Hsieh Yu-Chieh

entities.summary: Hsieh Yu-chieh, formerly known as Hsieh Shu-ying, is a Taiwanese professional tennis and pickleball player. She is the younger sister of tennis players Hsieh Su-wei and Hsieh Cheng-peng.
